About the rigs 🦴

This is a **first rigging prototype** for four MSM monsters. It uses original art pieces extracted from the provided data.zip and builds new joints and controls.

  • Source-authentic: sprite images and available mouth/eyelid/wing/tongue variations.
  • Reconstructed: skeleton positions, bone lengths, draw order, mirrored missing limb artwork, joint pivots and constraints.
  • Not recovered: precise original bone hierarchy, keyframes, hidden off-atlas sprites, game timing, or original rig weights.
  • IK: an actual analytic two-bone solver; if a target is too far, it clamps to reachable space.
  • Limitations: sprites are rigid cutouts or stretched limb art, not yet smooth-weighted mesh deformers. Expressions are frame swaps, not lip-sync. Browser editor saves pose/animation JSON, not a native Blender or Spine file.

To create a short clip, set frames at 0 and 24 (or more), pose differently at each, and use ▶ Play. Use Save animation JSON for an editable motion snapshot.
